title: Main line: lead → deal → enquiry → quotation → approval → sent → accepted → contract (two signatures) → work order → job → inspection → report issued → billable event → invoice → payment → profit → Tally
why: This is how the company earns money; one number typed at the start must arrive unchanged at the invoice and the profit line.
before: Test logins (Admin → User register → + Add a person, all in one office, e.g. Ahmedabad): zz.bdm (Business Development Manager), zz.mm (Marketing Manager), zz.fin (Finance), zz.om (Operation Manager), zz.bm (Branch Manager), zz.co (Coordinator), zz.ins (Inspector, linked to a team member), zz.srins (Senior Inspector, set as the inspector's approver in Admin → Approvals → Approver mapping). A quote approval rule covers ₹1,00,000 with approver Marketing Manager (Admin → Approvals → Quote & report approvals). The client below must NOT exist yet. Write every code/number the screens give you into the tester's sheet.

steps.do: [Business Development Manager] Left menu → Sales → Leads → '+ New lead'. '…or type a new company / person's name' = ZZ FLOW1 Engineering Pvt Ltd; Contact name = Ravi Flow; E-mail = your e-mail; Telephone; Where they came from = Referral; The requirement = 'Stage inspection of 4 pressure vessels'; Value they are worth = 100000; Allocated to = admin — me (yourself); Branch = your branch. Press 'Create it'.
steps.expect: Lead page opens headed 'ZZ FLOW1 Engineering Pvt Ltd' with a lead code and status Open. Note the LEAD CODE.

steps.do: [Business Development Manager] On the lead press 'Move to Qualified →'.
steps.expect: Stage shows Qualified; History tab records the move.

steps.do: [Business Development Manager] Press 'Work this as a deal →'.
steps.expect: An opportunity page opens (status Open, value ₹1,00,000). Back on the lead, 'Open the deal →' now appears. Note the DEAL CODE.

steps.do: [Business Development Manager] Sales → Inquiries → '+ New inquiry'. Client: '…or client name (if not yet registered)' = ZZ FLOW1 Engineering Pvt Ltd; Received date = today; Contact person = Ravi Flow; Business Unit = Industrial; Subject = 'ZZ FLOW1 stage inspection — 4 vessels'. 'Create inquiry'.
steps.expect: Inquiry register shows the new row, Status Open. Note the INQUIRY NO.

steps.do: [Business Development Manager] Inquiry register → that row → 'Quote'.
steps.expect: 'New quote' opens with client name and subject carried over (nothing retyped).

steps.do: [Business Development Manager] Business Unit (primary) = Industrial; tick 'Stage / In-process inspection'. '+ Add site': Name / label = Plant 1, Type = Manufacturer works, Address/City/State, Nearest Office = your office. '+ Add line': Business Unit Industrial, Activity, Service, Description = 'Stage inspection per vessel', Site = Plant 1, Order = Line-item order, Qty = 4, Unit = Per visit, Rate ₹ = 25000. Validity 30, GST % 18, Payment terms = Against invoice. 'Create quote'.
steps.expect: Quote page 'Q-… Draft'. Line Amount 1,00,000; total before tax ₹1,00,000. Note the QUOTE NO. Inquiry register now shows Status Quoted.

steps.do: [Business Development Manager] Open the deal (DEAL CODE) → Quotes tab.
steps.expect: Expected: the quotation is listed under 'Quotations on this deal'. If it is not (a quote raised from the enquiry is not tied to the deal), record as a gap — the lead → deal → enquiry → quote chain is not one linked thread; move the deal by hand ('Move it' → Quotation sent (50%)) and continue.

steps.do: [Business Development Manager] Quote → Actions → 'Submit for approval'.
steps.expect: Status Pending approval; 'Approval chain' table (Level · With whom · Status · Acted · Comment) shows Level 1 with the Marketing Manager. (If the screen says 'No approval needed — your approval rules do not cover this value.', the rule is missing — fix the rule first.)

steps.do: [Business Development Manager] Try to approve it yourself (no Approve button should be offered to you).
steps.expect: No 'Approve' for the preparer (BDM holds no approval right).

steps.do: [Marketing Manager] Sales → Quotes → open QUOTE NO (it waits for you to approve) → 'Approve'.
steps.expect: Status Approved; the chain row shows Approved by the Marketing Manager with the time.

steps.do: [Business Development Manager] Quote → '✉ Send to client'. Then '⬇ PDF (for client)'.
steps.expect: Status Sent. 'Edit' is no longer offered (a sent quote is locked; 'Revise (new rev)' is). The PDF shows ZZ FLOW1 Engineering Pvt Ltd, 4 × ₹25,000 = ₹1,00,000 plus GST 18%.

steps.do: [Business Development Manager] Quote → 'Mark accepted (won)'. If asked 'Before recording the acceptance: is … the same company as …?', press 'No — a different company, mark accepted'.
steps.expect: Status Accepted / closed-won. Directory → Client register now lists ZZ FLOW1 Engineering Pvt Ltd (Role Client). The deal shows Won; the lead shows Converted (if they were linked in step 7).

steps.do: [Finance] Sales → Quotes → QUOTE NO → section 'Won — client & contract registration (Accounts)' → '✓ Register the contract & request opening'.
steps.expect: A contract number is generated (value ₹1,00,000, dates and branch from the quote). Quote register 'Contract' column shows it. Note the CONTRACT NO. The opening is pending.

steps.do: [Coordinator] Try Operations → '＋ New work order' for ZZ FLOW1 with CONTRACT NO before it is opened.
steps.expect: Expected: the contract is not yet open to operations (it waits for two signatures) — not offered or refused. If a work order can be raised against an unopened contract, record as a defect.

steps.do: [Operation Manager] Open operations.mghaiapps.com/contract-openings ('Contract openings' — 'A manager endorses, then the branch manager approves…'). On CONTRACT NO press 'Endorse'.
steps.expect: The row shows endorsed by the Operation Manager; still waiting for approval.

steps.do: [Operation Manager] Press 'Approve & open' on the same row.
steps.expect: Not offered or refused — the Operation Manager can endorse but not approve.

steps.do: [Branch Manager] Contract openings → CONTRACT NO → 'Approve & open'.
steps.expect: Contract page reads 'Contract CONTRACT NO Open / in force', value ₹1,00,000, 'Quantity sold' 4 Per visit. (Endorser and approver are different people — two signatures.)

steps.do: [Coordinator] Operations → '＋ New work order'. Client = ZZ FLOW1 Engineering Pvt Ltd; 'Quote — what was sold' = QUOTE NO; 'Contract number — from the quote' fills with CONTRACT NO; line item = the stage inspection line; Vendor / manufacturer (site) as on the quote; Business Unit Industrial; Activity code; Service line = Inspection; Type of inspection = Stage / In-process inspection; inspection date; offices = your office. 'Save work order'.
steps.expect: Page 'Work order …' with Stage · Target · Actual · Status. Work order register row: Client ZZ FLOW1, Executing Office yours. Contract page 'Work orders raised under this contract' lists it. Note the WORK ORDER NO.

steps.do: [Coordinator] Work order → 'Change status (only the valid next steps are listed)' → Accepted → 'Set'; then Ready for scheduling → 'Set'.
steps.expect: Only valid next steps offered; status moves; history kept.

steps.do: [Coordinator] Work order → '+ Allocate another job' (or Operations home 'Allocate engineer'). Choose Executing office = your office, Engineer = the inspector of zz.ins, the date. Press 'Allocate & send email'.
steps.expect: Job page 'Job …'. Work order's 'Jobs allocated from this call' lists it with Expected credit. Operations → Scheduling board shows the inspector busy on that date. Note the JOB NO.

steps.do: [Inspector, on phone] Sign in as zz.ins → My Jobs → 'To do' → the job → 'Open'.
steps.expect: Job details readable on the phone: client, site, contact, QAP documents.

steps.do: [Inspector, on phone] On the job press '📑 New report'. Report type = IR — Inspection Report; Title = 'ZZ FLOW1 stage inspection'; Inspection date = the job date. 'Generate report'. Fill the report, then '✓ Submit for review'.
steps.expect: Report shows status Under review (or At vetting); an IRN has been generated. Note the IRN.

steps.do: [Senior Inspector — the mapped approver] Reporting → Report register → IRN → '✓ Approve'.
steps.expect: Status Approved — 'Approved — ready to issue.'

steps.do: [Senior Inspector] Try 'Finalize & issue' on the same report.
steps.expect: Refused — the person who approved cannot issue (approver ≠ issuer).

steps.do: [Branch Manager] Reporting → Report register → IRN → 'Finalize & issue'.
steps.expect: Status Issued with 🔒; '📄 PDF' works; the client portal (if switched on) lists it under Reports.

steps.do: [Inspector, on phone] My Jobs → the job → 'Close & record expenses': Report upload date = today, Travel (₹) 500, others 0. 'Close job & record expenses'.
steps.expect: Job leaves 'To do'. Job register shows the job Closed.

steps.do: [Finance] Money → Billable events → '⟳ Sync from closed work'. Filter Status = Pending review.
steps.expect: A row for JOB NO: Client ZZ FLOW1, Contract CONTRACT NO, Service, Amount ₹25,000 (the quote's per-visit rate), Status Pending review. If the amount differs from the quote rate, screenshot it as a FAIL.

steps.do: [Finance] Press 'Approve' on that row.
steps.expect: Status Approved to bill.

steps.do: [Finance] Money → Billing workspace ('Work waiting to be billed'). Month = this month → Apply. Under ZZ FLOW1 → CONTRACT NO tick 'Include' for JOB NO → 'Draft invoice for the ticked work'.
steps.expect: An invoice in Draft opens for ZZ FLOW1 with one line ₹25,000 + GST 18% = ₹29,500, Contract number = CONTRACT NO. No invoice number yet ('Nothing is numbered until it is issued').

steps.do: [Coordinator] Open the draft invoice and look for 'Issue this invoice'.
steps.expect: Not available to the Coordinator — only Accounts issues.

steps.do: [Finance] Press 'Issue this invoice' → confirm.
steps.expect: Invoice number from your branch's series (pattern as Admin → System settings → Document numbering 'Example'); status Issued; due date = invoice date + the client's credit days. Billable events row now Billed.

steps.do: [Finance] Invoice page → 'Record money received'. Customer = ZZ FLOW1, Branch, How it came = Bank transfer, Amount in the bank = 29000, TDS the customer withheld = 500. 'Record it'.
steps.expect: Message asks which invoices it settles; press 'Match it' against the invoice.

steps.do: [Finance] Money → Invoices and Money → Receivables ageing.
steps.expect: Invoice Settled ₹29,500 (29,000 + 500 TDS), Outstanding 0, status Paid. Ageing shows nothing owed by ZZ FLOW1.

steps.do: [Finance] Money → Profit by work order → this month → Show. Find JOB NO.
steps.expect: Revenue ₹25,000; Expenses include ₹500 travel; Profit = Revenue − Total cost. Money → Contract number register shows CONTRACT NO with Jobs 1 and Invoicing done.

steps.do: [Business Director] Insights → Management dashboard → this month → filter Client = ZZ FLOW1.
steps.expect: Inspections 1, Closed 1, Revenue ₹25,000 — same as Profit by work order.

steps.do: [Finance] Money → Tally export. What = Sales vouchers (invoices raised), From/To covering today → 'Show'. Press '⬇ CSV (to look at first)'. Then What = Receipt vouchers → Show.
steps.expect: The invoice row shows party ZZ FLOW1, GSTIN/place of supply, Taxable 25,000, CGST+SGST (same state) or IGST (other state), Total 29,500; the receipt appears in Receipt vouchers with TDS 500. (Use '⬇ Tally XML (import this)' only when really handing over — it is recorded under 'Batches already handed over'.)

steps.do: [Master Admin] Admin → MGH Books.
steps.expect: If 'Books is connected' is off: EXAACT is the record (pass). If on: Integration health shows the invoice and receipt sent, and the invoice page shows Books' paid/outstanding.

title: Manpower supply: project costing → man-month quotation → accepted → requisition → candidate → joining → deployment → monthly attendance → billing
why: Technical staffing is billed by the man-month; the costed rate must be the quoted rate, the deployed person must be the hired one, and the billed days must be the approved days.
before: Test logins (Admin → User register → + Add a person, all in one office, e.g. Ahmedabad): zz.bdm (Business Development Manager), zz.mm (Marketing Manager), zz.fin (Finance), zz.om (Operation Manager), zz.bm (Branch Manager), zz.co (Coordinator), zz.ins (Inspector, linked to a team member), zz.srins (Senior Inspector, set as the inspector's approver in Admin → Approvals → Approver mapping). A client ZZ FLOW2 Refinery Ltd (Directory, payment terms set). Sales → Set up Sales: 'Must a man-month quote come from an approved project costing…' = Yes (default).

steps.do: [Business Development Manager] Sales → Project costing → '＋ New costing'. Title = ZZ FLOW2 Hazira QA/QC deputation; Client = ZZ FLOW2 Refinery Ltd; Executing office = yours; Site = Hazira; Basis = Long — per man-month × BOQ. 'Create costing'.
steps.expect: Costing page '… Draft' with a PC code. Note the COSTING CODE.

steps.do: [Business Development Manager] '＋ Add a role': Role = QA/QC Engineer; Personnel / salary 60000; Statutory 8000; Accommodation / rentals 10000; Food / meal allowance 6000; Units (BOQ) = 6; Target margin (%) = 20. 'Add role'.
steps.expect: Row shows Direct/mo, Loaded/mo, Rate/lump, Units 6, Revenue, Profit, Margin ≈ 20%. Note the RATE (per man-month) and REVENUE.

steps.do: [Business Development Manager] Press 'Submit for approval'. Then try to approve it yourself.
steps.expect: Status Submitted. Your own approval is refused — the author never approves a costing.

steps.do: [Marketing Manager] Open the costing → Approval → approve.
steps.expect: Status Approved, with who and when.

steps.do: [Business Development Manager] Costing → '📝 Create quotation'.
steps.expect: A Draft quote for ZZ FLOW2 with a line Unit = Man-month, Qty = 6, Rate = the costing RATE; total = costing REVENUE. Note QUOTE NO.

steps.do: [Marketing Manager] Edit the quote and change the rate (you are not its creator).
steps.expect: Expected: refused — only the quotation's creator (or a master of quotations) may move prices away from the costing, and then only with a note written in its history. If someone else can change it silently, record as a defect.

steps.do: [Business Development Manager] Submit for approval → [Marketing Manager] Approve → [Business Development Manager] '✉ Send to client' → 'Mark accepted (won)'.
steps.expect: Status Accepted. Quote still shows Man-month × 6 at RATE.

steps.do: [Finance] Quote → '✓ Register the contract & request opening'. [Operation Manager] Contract openings → 'Endorse'. [Branch Manager] 'Approve & open'.
steps.expect: Contract Open / in force; Quantity sold 6 Man-month; value = REVENUE. Note CONTRACT NO.

steps.do: [Coordinator] Sales → Project costing → COSTING CODE → on the role press '→ Requirement'.
steps.expect: Message 'Recruitment Requisition REQ-… created from this role — set the headcount & duration.' The requisition page opens: status Open, client ZZ FLOW2, site Hazira. Note REQ NO.

steps.do: [Coordinator] Requisition → Edit: headcount 1, duration per the contract. 'Add source': Source = Direct recruitment, How many people = 1. 'Add source'.
steps.expect: 'Where these people come from' shows 1 promised to Direct recruitment.

steps.do: [Coordinator] Recruitment → '＋ Add candidate'. Against requisition = REQ NO; First name = ZZ Flow2; Last name = Candidate; Client = ZZ FLOW2 Refinery Ltd; Experience 6. 'Add candidate'.
steps.expect: Candidate page 'ZZ Flow2 Candidate' stage CV received; requisition 'Candidates against this requisition (1)'.

steps.do: [Coordinator] Candidate → 'Client submission & interview': CV submitted to client on = today; Client feedback = Shortlisted; Interview outcome = Selected. 'Save tracking'.
steps.expect: Candidate register tabs 'Submitted to client' / 'Shortlisted' count the candidate.

steps.do: [Coordinator] Candidate → Offer: 'Draft offer' with Total CTC and Joining date.
steps.expect: Offer drafted (offer approval follows Recruitment approvals).

steps.do: [Coordinator] Candidate → 'Move this candidate' → New stage = Accepted (Hired); Which team do they join? = Field — goes to site; On whose roll? = On our roll. 'Update stage'.
steps.expect: Stage Accepted (Hired); the requisition's Placements shows 1 hired. The person now exists as a team member.

steps.do: [Coordinator] Operations → Team member availability.
steps.expect: ZZ Flow2 Candidate is listed (Available) under the right office.

steps.do: [Coordinator] Operations → '＋ New work order': Client ZZ FLOW2, Quote = QUOTE NO, contract CONTRACT NO, Service line = Project Deputation. Save. Then allocate: Engineer = ZZ Flow2 Candidate, shape = man-month basis, months 6. 'Allocate & send email'.
steps.expect: Job created; Operations → Deputation & site operations lists Person ZZ Flow2 Candidate, Client ZZ FLOW2, Site Hazira, Status Planned.

steps.do: [Coordinator] Job → '👷 Deputation & site operations' → Set status = Mobilized → 'Update status'; then Active.
steps.expect: Status Active; Deputations register shows Active; 'Manpower plan & gap' Gap reduces by 1.

steps.do: [Coordinator] Month end: Job → '➕ Submit an attendance period for client approval': Period from 1st, Period to last day, Basis = Man-month, Billable days = 26. 'Submit for approval'.
steps.expect: Row in 'Attendance approval & billing sign-off' with status Submitted.

steps.do: [Client portal user, or Coordinator for the client] Approve the period (portal 'Deputations', or on the job set status Approved with Client rep name → 'Save').
steps.expect: Status Approved; row shows 'locked'.

steps.do: [Finance] Money → Billable events → '⟳ Sync from closed work'.
steps.expect: A row for the approved deputation timesheet for ZZ FLOW2 / CONTRACT NO, Pending review, quantity 26 days (man-month basis).

steps.do: [Finance] 'Approve' the row. Then Money → Invoices → '+ New invoice': Customer ZZ FLOW2, Branch, Contract number = CONTRACT NO → 'Start the draft'; 'Add the line' for 1 man-month at RATE → 'Issue this invoice'.
steps.expect: Invoice issued for one man-month at the costing RATE.

steps.do: [Finance] Billable events → that row → 'Mark billed' with invoice # = the new invoice number.
steps.expect: Status Billed with the invoice number (a non-job event needs the invoice number).

steps.do: [Finance] Money → Profit by work order (this month) and Recruitment home 'Manpower P&L'.
steps.expect: Revenue for the deputation equals RATE; cost shows the person's salary; margin close to the costed 20% (differences explained by actual days).

steps.do: [Business Development Manager] Try to submit a second man-month quote with no approved costing.
steps.expect: Refused while the man-month line has no approved project costing.

title: Quality loop: complaint → nonconformity → corrective action → closure → management review
why: An assessor follows one complaint from arrival to the management review; every date, owner and decision must be on the record.
before: Test logins (Admin → User register → + Add a person, all in one office, e.g. Ahmedabad): zz.bdm (Business Development Manager), zz.mm (Marketing Manager), zz.fin (Finance), zz.om (Operation Manager), zz.bm (Branch Manager), zz.co (Coordinator), zz.ins (Inspector, linked to a team member), zz.srins (Senior Inspector, set as the inspector's approver in Admin → Approvals → Approver mapping). Also zz.qh (Quality Head). FLOW-01 done (JOB NO and IRN exist).

steps.do: [Coordinator] Left menu → Quality & Accreditation → Complaints & appeals → 'Record one'. What is it? = Complaint; Received on = today; How it reached us = E-mail; Who from = Client; Their name = Ravi Flow; Which client = ZZ FLOW1 Engineering Pvt Ltd; Which team member = the FLOW-01 inspector; Job number = JOB NO; Report number (IRN) = IRN; Subject = ZZ FLOW3 report issued late; What they told us = 'Report came 8 days after inspection'. 'Record it'.
steps.expect: Complaint page 'CMP-… — ZZ FLOW3 report issued late', tabs Overview · Handle · History. Register row with Received date. Note CMP NO.

steps.do: [Coordinator] Handle → '1 · Acknowledge' → 'Record it'; '2 · Is it ours to answer?' → 'Save'; '3 · Investigate' → findings → 'Save findings'.
steps.expect: Each step dated in 'What happened, in order'; register shows the acknowledgement date within the 'Acknowledge within (days)' deadline.

steps.do: [Coordinator] Quality → Nonconformity workspace → NCR register → '+ Raise a nonconformity'. What was wrong = ZZ FLOW3 report late; Where it came from = A complaint; Reference at the source = CMP NO; Major; Against a job = JOB NO; Owner = Quality Head; Due by blank. 'Raise it'.
steps.expect: NCR page 'NCR-… — ZZ FLOW3 report late', 'Major Open A complaint'; Due date = 14 days from today (blank = 14 days if major). Note NCR NO.

steps.do: [Quality Head] NCR → '1 · What was done immediately' → text → 'Save'. '2 · What happened to the work that was already wrong' = Correct and re-issue the document → 'Record it'.
steps.expect: Both recorded with name and date.

steps.do: [Quality Head] Try '4 · Close it' now.
steps.expect: Refused — 'Before this can be closed' lists the missing corrective action (a major one cannot be closed without one).

steps.do: [Quality Head] '3 · Does it need a corrective action?' → 'Open a corrective action from this'.
steps.expect: CAPA page 'CAPA-… — …' 'Major · raised today · A nonconformity'; 'Quality case — the full story (2 linked)'. Note CAPA NO.

steps.do: [Quality Head] CAPA → '1 · Cause': Root cause, How it was worked out = Five whys, elsewhere = No — we looked… → 'Save'. '2 · Plan' → What will be done, Whose job, By when → 'Save plan'. '3 · It was done' → Carried out on = today → 'Record it'.
steps.expect: Each step recorded in 'What happened, in order'.

steps.do: [Coordinator] Try '5 · Close' on the CAPA.
steps.expect: Not offered / refused (closing a corrective action needs capa.close — Quality or Technical Head).

steps.do: [Quality Head] '4 · Did it work?' = Yes — it worked → 'Record the check'. '5 · Close' → 'Close …'.
steps.expect: CAPA status Closed. (Choosing 'No — it did not' instead offers 'Close as ineffective and raise a further action'.)

steps.do: [Quality Head] NCR NO → '4 · Close it'.
steps.expect: NCR Closed with closure date; register Status Closed.

steps.do: [Master Admin — not involved in the case] Complaint CMP NO → '4 · Decide' → 'Record the decision'. Check 'Who may not decide this'.
steps.expect: Decision recorded; the inspector and the recorder are listed as people who may not decide. Note: by default only administrators hold 'Decide complaints and appeals' — the Quality Head cannot decide. Record as a gap for the owner (who should decide complaints).

steps.do: [Coordinator] Complaint → '5 · Tell the complainant' → Save; '7 · Close' → Close.
steps.expect: State closed; register columns Outcome, Decided by, Told filled.

steps.do: [Quality Head] Open Quality & Accreditation → Management review.
steps.expect: Expected for the owner's quality role: opens. Today the Quality Head holds no 'Internal audits & management review' right by default — if refused, record as a gap and continue as Master Admin.

steps.do: [Master Admin] Management review → 'Hold a review': Held on = today, Period from = first of this month, to = today, Chaired by = Rahul Desai. 'Open it'.
steps.expect: Review page 'MR-… — management review' with 'The required inputs (§8.9.2 — all 15)'.

steps.do: [Master Admin] Press 'Re-count from the system'.
steps.expect: The complaints, nonconformities and corrective-action inputs count CMP NO, NCR NO and CAPA NO.

steps.do: [Master Admin] 'Record a decision': About = The management system and its processes; Whose job; By when; The decision = 'Report TAT alert at 5 days'. 'Record it'. Then 'Complete the review'.
steps.expect: Decision row in 'What came out of it'; review State completed; Management review list shows Decisions 1.

steps.do: [Business Director] Insights → Analytics & performance → 'Quality' view, this month.
steps.expect: 'Open nonconformities' does not include NCR NO; 'Average NCR closure time' includes it; 'CAPA effectiveness' counts CAPA NO as effective.

title: Marketplace: requirement → applications → award → engagement → voucher → invoice → payout
why: The marketplace earns commission on the fee only; the professional's payout and the client's bill must come from one approved voucher.
before: Test logins (Admin → User register → + Add a person, all in one office, e.g. Ahmedabad): zz.bdm (Business Development Manager), zz.mm (Marketing Manager), zz.fin (Finance), zz.om (Operation Manager), zz.bm (Branch Manager), zz.co (Coordinator), zz.ins (Inspector, linked to a team member), zz.srins (Senior Inspector, set as the inspector's approver in Admin → Approvals → Approver mapping). Marketplace & Connect switched on. A verified test professional login (marketplace portal) available to the tester. Client ZZ FLOW1 exists.

What do you need? = ZZ FLOW4 UT technician 10 days; Posted for = ZZ FLOW1 Engineering Pvt Ltd; Work type = Day rate; Discipline = NDT; Location = Vadodara; Positions = 1; Start/End dates; Rate from 3000, Rate to 4000. 'Post it — open for applications'.
steps.expect: 'All requirements' shows a CX-REQ code with Status Open. Note REQ CODE.

steps.do: [Professional] From the marketplace portal, open REQ CODE and apply with a day rate of 3500.
steps.expect: Applied.

steps.do: [Coordinator] Requirement page → Applications (1).
steps.expect: The application shows status Applied with the rate.

steps.do: [Coordinator] Press 'Start shortlisting', then 'Shortlist' on the application.
steps.expect: Requirement Shortlisting; application Shortlisted.

steps.do: [Coordinator] '🤝 Award' on the application → confirm 'Award this requirement to …?'.

steps.do: [Coordinator] Booking / engagement → Basis = Man-days; Rate ₹ = 3500; Per = day; Quantity = 10; Rate model = Fee only (expenses extra); Voucher cadence = Per deployment / month. 'Update booking'. Then 'Mark active'.

steps.do: [Coordinator] Billing → '💷 Send to billing'.

steps.do: [Coordinator] Press 'Send back' with a note, then (professional) correct and resubmit.
steps.expect: Status 'Sent back', then Submitted again.

steps.do: [Coordinator] Press 'Approve'.
steps.expect: Voucher Approved; receipts frozen. A Draft tax invoice for the voucher appears in Money → Invoices for ZZ FLOW1 (fee and expense lines).

steps.do: [Finance] Money → Billable events.
steps.expect: The award event from step 7 (₹3,500) is listed too. If both the award event and the voucher invoice would bill the same work, record as a gap (possible double billing) and 'Dispute'/do not bill the award event.

steps.do: [Coordinator] Engagement vouchers → 'Mark paid' (after the client has paid and the professional confirmed receipt).

title: Approval set-up drives quotation routing: bands, levels in order, delegation while away, escalation
why: Admin's approval rules are only right if a real quotation goes to the right people in the right order.
before: Test logins (Admin → User register → + Add a person, all in one office, e.g. Ahmedabad): zz.bdm (Business Development Manager), zz.mm (Marketing Manager), zz.fin (Finance), zz.om (Operation Manager), zz.bm (Branch Manager), zz.co (Coordinator), zz.ins (Inspector, linked to a team member), zz.srins (Senior Inspector, set as the inspector's approver in Admin → Approvals → Approver mapping). Plus zz.mm2 (second Marketing Manager). Do at a quiet time; the test rules are removed at the end. Sales → Set up Sales: 'If a quote waits too long…' = After 1 day (note the current answer to restore it).

steps.do: [Master Admin] Sales → Quotes → 'Approval rules' → '+ Add rule': ZZ L1, Level 1, Active, Any business unit, Amount from 200000, up to 0 (no upper limit), Approver role = Marketing Manager. Add another: ZZ L2, Level 2, Active, from 200000, up to 0, '…or a specific person' = zz.mm2.
steps.expect: Both rules listed (Level · Rule · Applies to · From ₹ · Up to ₹ · Approver · Status).

steps.do: [Business Development Manager] New quote for ZZ FLOW1: one line ₹3,00,000 before tax → 'Create quote' → 'Submit for approval'.
steps.expect: Approval chain: Level 1 Marketing Manager, Level 2 zz.mm2, both pending. (A ₹1,90,000 quote would not match — values are measured before tax.)

steps.do: [zz.mm2] Try to approve Level 2 first.
steps.expect: Refused — levels sign in order.

steps.do: [Marketing Manager] Sales → Quotes → 'Who covers for a quotation approver' (/quote-delegations): Who is away = zz.mm, Who acts for them = zz.mm2, From today, To tomorrow, Reason = ZZ leave. 'Add delegation'.
steps.expect: Row with State active.

steps.do: [zz.mm2] Approve Level 1 (as delegate), then Level 2.
steps.expect: Level 1 recorded as signed by zz.mm2 for zz.mm; Level 2 signed; quote Approved. (If one person is not allowed to sign two levels of the same quotation, note the message — that is acceptable; then sign Level 2 with another approver.)

steps.do: [Business Development Manager] A second ₹3,00,000 quote → Submit. Wait one day without Level 1 signing. [zz.mm2] (Level 2 approver) open it.
steps.expect: After 1 day the Level 1 step is open to the next level's approvers: zz.mm2 can sign it.

steps.do: [Business Development Manager] A third quote of ₹1,90,000 before tax (₹2,24,200 with GST) → 'Submit for approval'.
steps.expect: No ZZ rule matches (values are measured before tax); the company's answer for an uncovered value applies (default: the approvers of your highest level).

steps.do: [Marketing Manager] On the second ₹3,00,000 quote press 'Reject' at Level 1 without a reason, then with reason 'ZZ rate too low'.
steps.expect: Without a reason: refused. With a reason: status Rejected; the chain ends there (Level 2 not asked).

steps.do: [Business Development Manager] On the rejected quote: 'Edit first', correct the rate, then '↻ Submit for approval again'.
steps.expect: Chain rebuilt from scratch; the earlier rejection stays in the history.

steps.do: [Business Development Manager] On the approved first quote: '✉ Send to client'.
steps.expect: Sent; History shows each approval with who signed and 'for zz.mm' where a delegate signed.

steps.do: [Master Admin] Delete ZZ L1 and ZZ L2 ('✕'); end the delegation; restore Set up Sales.
steps.expect: Company rules back to how they were.

steps.do: [Business Development Manager] Mark the remaining ZZ test quotes lost ('Mark lost', reason).
steps.expect: Test data closed off.

title: Admin change ripples into every area: module switch, terminology, report format, working norms
why: Admin is the root of the dependency tree; each change must reach the other areas immediately and revert cleanly.
before: Test logins (Admin → User register → + Add a person, all in one office, e.g. Ahmedabad): zz.bdm (Business Development Manager), zz.mm (Marketing Manager), zz.fin (Finance), zz.om (Operation Manager), zz.bm (Branch Manager), zz.co (Coordinator), zz.ins (Inspector, linked to a team member), zz.srins (Senior Inspector, set as the inspector's approver in Admin → Approvals → Approver mapping). Quiet time. Note current wording of 'Work order', the Inspection report format, and Inspector working norms.

steps.do: [Master Admin] Admin → Terminology / wording → Operations: Work order singular/plural = 'Call' / 'Calls' → 'Save terminology'.
steps.expect: Saved.

steps.do: [Coordinator] Operations home, Work order register, a work order page, the New work order button.
steps.expect: All read 'Call(s)'. Stored records and numbers unchanged.

steps.do: [Master Admin] Admin → Report formats by service: Inspection = Stage Inspection Report (SIR) → 'Save report formats'.
steps.expect: Saved.

steps.do: [Coordinator] New work order with Service line Inspection → allocate.
steps.expect: Job's report format = SIR.

steps.do: [Branch Manager] Working norms: Inspector, your office, 5 days, 40 hours → 'Save norm'.
steps.expect: Insights → Dashboards utilisation for the CURRENT month changes (and past months too — no effective date, D-F6).

steps.do: [Master Admin] Quality & Accreditation → SLA targets (or Operations home 'SLA targets'): Client = — all clients (default) —, Stage = Response, Target (days) = 1 → 'Save target'.
steps.expect: Row in Current targets (Client · Stage · Target (days) · Note).

steps.do: [Coordinator] Open a new work order → 'Timing & SLA' tab.
steps.expect: Stage · Target · Actual · Status shows Response target 1 day. (A stage with no target shows 'N/A'.)

steps.do: [Master Admin] Admin → Masters → dropdown list 'Product category' → '+ Add a value' ZZ TEST Category → 'Add value'.
steps.expect: Operations → ＋ New work order → 'Product category' offers ZZ TEST Category.

steps.do: [Master Admin] Admin → Company profile → Brand / trading name + ' ZZ' → 'Save company profile'. Open a quote PDF and an invoice print.
steps.expect: Both show the new brand name. Revert afterwards.

steps.do: [Master Admin] Revert all changes: terminology, report format, working norm ('Remove'), SLA target ('Remove'), ZZ TEST Category ('Delete'), brand name.
steps.expect: Everything back as it was; Dashboards figures back.

steps.do: [Master Admin] Admin → Modules & features → a module the company does not use → 'Turn off this feature' → 'Turn it off & hide these'; then 'Add this to my workspace'.
steps.expect: Its area vanishes from every role's menu while off and returns with its records intact (ADM-004).
